Q: package specified with braces gives error when it contains a __DATA__ section A:

Perl does not consider lines after the __DATA__ lint to be code. That is why it does not see the closing }.

DATA:

__DATA__ may be used to indicate the logical end of the script before the actual end of file. Any following text is ignored by the interpreter unless read by the program as described below.

Q: Add unaccent to text search A:

With that alter database you changed the db-wide default value for the default_text_search_config setting but for it to apply to live sessions including yours, you'd have to reconnect. You can also change the current value from inside the session, with a regular set:

demo at db<>fiddle

set default_text_search_config to 'portugues_sem_acento';

select to_tsvector('Cação')
     , plainto_tsquery('cacao')
     , to_tsvector('Cação') @@ to_tsquery('cacao');
to_tsvector plainto_tsquery ?column?
'caca':1 'caca' t 
SELECT * FROM ts_debug('portugues_sem_acento', 'Cação');
alias description token dictionaries dictionary lexemes
word Word, all letters Cação {unaccent,portuguese_stem} unaccent {Cacao}

Q: Floor of Natural Logarithm A:

Even for subsequence n=2^k for k=1,2,3,.. you effectively need to calculate ⌊(2^k)*ln(2)⌋ which is first k binary digits of ln(2). I know no "simple" algorithm for determine sequence of digits in ln(2) representation. That means no simple algorithm exists for your initial task.
